primary_splits.patient_source: Pinned HEST_v1_1_0.csv; global HEST patient IDs
primary_splits.limitations: Only four patients. Two train, one validation, one test; insufficient for publication-level inference.

protocol.graph_selection: Per panel and model, seed 0 only: highest validation median gene Pearson, then lowest validation MSE, then graph name. No test graph selection.
protocol.architecture: One aggregation layer followed by GELU, frozen C1 dropout and a direct output head. MEAN uses row-normalized A+I; GCN uses symmetric D^-1/2(A+I)D^-1/2; SAGE concatenates self features with neighbor-only row means. Aggregation of frozen input embeddings is precomputed, exactly equivalent to one-layer learned linear GCN/mean-GraphSAGE.
protocol.capacity: MEAN/GCN match frozen C1 hidden width and parameter count. SAGE width is the nearest integer matching C1 parameter count after accounting for doubled input dimension. No new architecture sweep.
protocol.training: Frozen C1 AdamW, learning rate, weight decay, batch size, patience, minimum improvement and max epochs. Primary early stopping uses validation MSE. Three main seeds.
protocol.scaling: Use frozen C1 primary feature/target scalers before aggregation. Conditional LOPO uses the existing C1 fold-specific scalers read-only; no new learned scaling or C1 refitting.
protocol.controls: S2-50, each selected model, seeds 0/1/2: independently permute graph vertex labels per slide, preserving degree/edge structure but breaking physical proximity. No labels enter graph construction. Train/validation/test all receive deterministic permuted graphs.
protocol.lopo: All four panels, three models, seeds 0/1/2 and four evaluation patients. Use primary-selected graphs and fixed rounded median primary best epoch. Compare to frozen C1 LOPO B2 metrics by identical patient/panel/seed. Conditional sensitivity only, not unbiased validation.
protocol.contextual_gain: Gene Pearson(model) minus frozen gene Pearson(C1 B2), paired by panel, patient, seed. Also report gains over selected MEAN pooling, MSE/MAE changes, and validation graph sensitivity.
protocol.candidate_gene_rule: Freeze descriptive validation shortlist per multi-gene panel and graph model before test access: mean graph-minus-MEAN Pearson >=0.05, all three seed graph-minus-MEAN gains positive, and mean MSE change <=0. Frozen C1 validation per-gene predictions were not stored, so no new C1 inference is performed to create them. Report test/conditional-LOPO gains over frozen C1 local and MEAN for the unchanged shortlist.
protocol.prohibitions: No C1 fitting/replay/retuning, new encoder, observed neighboring expression, S3 masks, multiresolution fusion, GAT, explanation or biological interpretation. No C3 execution.

gene_analysis_rules.gain_denominator: Frozen C1 B2, paired by panel, patient and seed; graph-vs-MEAN also paired by panel/patient/seed, each method using its own validation-selected graph.

gene_support_rule.interpretation: Descriptive prioritization, not a significance test or proof of independent replication. Conditional folds overlap and reuse frozen panels.

gene_analysis_rules.reporting: Report all genes, not only shortlisted genes, including negative gains and disagreement between correlation and error. No selection from primary test metrics or retrospective graph search.

integrity_audit.C0_C1_integrity: unchanged, verified by frozen hashes only

decision.conclusion: Modest broader-panel gains and a descriptive subset, but no general spatial-GNN advantage established
decision.C3_recommendation: Review; resolve broader-panel shuffled-neighbor and matched self-only controls in a separate version before a multiresolution claim

local_binary_note: C2/models and C2/predictions are local and hashed but excluded from Git. Frozen C1 is never retrained or replayed by C2.
